notes.title: GridFront Scout version 0 baseline
notes.description: This is the first tracked version of the OAK standalone tablet app: the tablet owns setup and display, while the OAK-D camera runs perception and sends live proximity detections.
items: The Oukitel tablet runs a locked-down GridFront Scout kiosk with a live cab radar and field-service settings.
The OAK-D standalone pipeline performs detection, depth, tracking, coordinate transform, and zone classification on the camera.
Tablet and camera communicate over the direct USB-C Ethernet link using UDP detection packets on 5556 and config sync on 5557.
Detection messages now use schema 1 with numeric scene and zone codes: 0 for no detections, 1 for outside-zone detections, 2 for yellow-zone detections, and 3 for red-zone detections.
The Scout ecosystem technical overview PDF documents the product architecture, live JSON payloads, config sync, and planned multi-camera behavior for up to six OAK-D cameras on one tablet.
